note: Fibonacci retracements and Gann eighths for 400 stocks. For each: how often price reached it, and whether a BOUNCE of 1% came before a BREAK of 1%, within 5 sessions. Below 20 touches the rate is withheld.

cautions.description_not_prediction: A held rate describes the past. It is not a promise that the level holds next time.
cautions.coin_toss_test: A rate near 50% means the level is no better than a coin toss. That is the honest baseline to read every row against.
cautions.closes_only: Built from closing prices, and a touch means the close came within 1.5% of the level - a zone, not a hairline.
cautions.no_astrology: Gann eighths and Fibonacci ratios are arithmetic on a price range. Nothing here uses planetary positions or dates.

ratio_finding: Across every stock, the gann 12.5% zone was held 54.3% of the time (1,272 touches, bounce before break); the weakest, gann 87.5%, held 32.5% (1,385 touches). A rate near 50% would mean the level is no better than a coin toss.
